name: configuration-error-handling
local-model-routing-decision
prompt: A coding assistant can either reason with a hosted frontier model or delegate a bounded read-only task to a local 27B quantized model. The local model has a 16K context window and no per-token charge, but its output must be checked by the hosted model. Design a routing policy that genuinely reduces hosted usage without lowering final-answer reliability. Include measurable acceptance criteria and fail-closed behavior.
